summary: Describes how to set up different types (e.g., Positive, Negative) and categories (e.g., Behavior) for student feedback in the master setup. It also covers the process of recording feedback for a student, including selecting the feedback type and category, adding detailed comments, attaching files, and sending notifications.
navigation: Student Master Setup -> Student Feedback Type
Student Master Setup -> Student Feedback Category
steps: To set up feedback types and categories:
Define 'Student Feedback Category' (e.g., Behavior, Academic Performance).
Select the specific student for whom feedback is being recorded.
Add detailed comments in the feedback description field.
Optionally, attach any relevant files or documents.
Optionally, send a notification to the student regarding the feedback.
business_rules: Feedback types and categories must be configured in the master setup before they can be used for recording feedback.
Notifications for student feedback can be enabled or disabled as needed.
important_notes: Feedback can be recorded by teachers or other authorized staff members.
The system allows for attachments to be included with feedback records.
questions: How do I set up different types of student feedback (e.g., positive, negative)?
Where can I define categories for student feedback, such as 'Behavior' or 'Academic'?
What is the process for recording feedback for a specific student?
